# Ponde Meats (pondemeats.com)
> South Australia's Premier Wholesale & Bulk Butcher · Cowirra SA

## Identity & Facility
- Legal Name: Ponde Meats Pty Ltd
- ABN: 42 395 857 236 (https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=42395857236)
- Facility Address: 32 Loxton Rd, Cowirra SA 5238, Australia
- Phone: +61 485 901 075 / 0485 901 075
- Email: info@pondemeats.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri: 6:00 AM – 4:30 PM | Sat: 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM

## Core Categories
- Beef: Pasture-raised prime ribeye tomahawks, scotch fillets, sides of beef (~120kg hung weight), freezer boxes.
- Lamb: French trimmed racks, cutlets, legs, whole pasture lamb carcasses (~24kg hung weight).
- Boer Goat: Bone-in diced curry/biryani cuts, whole Boer goat carcasses (~18kg hung weight), shanks.
- Mutton: Heritage Australian pasture mutton shoulder chops, whole mutton carcasses (~26kg hung weight).

## Wholesale Order Rules & Pricing
- Currency: AUD (GST included)
- Minimum Order: $200 AUD
- Free Delivery Threshold: $1,000 AUD (under $1,000 is flat $20 refrigerated delivery)
- Alternative Payment Discount: 5% instant discount on Bank Transfer (OSKO) and PayID
- Cold-Chain: Certified 0–3°C unbroken temperature-controlled transport across SA & Interstate.

## Real-Time API Endpoints
- GET /api/products : Returns complete meat catalog
- GET /api/categories : Returns livestock categories
- GET /api/search?q={query} : Search cuts and carcasses
- POST /api/mcp : Streamable Model Context Protocol HTTP endpoint
- GET /api/acp/catalog : Agent Commerce Protocol catalog
- GET /api/ucp/services : Universal Commerce Protocol services
